segments.title: January
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! Happy New Year, team. January is the one month when people walk in already wanting to change. Our theme is Resolutions with Receipts: we help people keep the promise, not just make it.

segments.title: ₹1.93L
segments.text: So, the number. Our January target for Pop-up is 1.93 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent up on last January. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 85,000 rupees. That's 4 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 82,700, comebacks 23,600, and everything else 1,900. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 51 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 596 leads, 155 trials, and 51 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 75,500 rupees, which is 39 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Third Time's the Charm
segments.text: First up, Third Time's the Charm. Three classes for the price of two. The first class is awkward, the second is better, the third, they're hooked. Book class two before they leave class one. The plan is 3 buyers at about 5,900, so 17,700 rupees.

segments.title: U Up? It's 2027.
segments.text: Next, for lapsed members, U Up? It's 2027. Fifteen per cent off to come back, and five bonus days for anyone who hits twelve classes in January. Their mat has been asking about them. The plan is 3 buyers at about 7,200, so 21,700 rupees.
segments.notes: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned)

segments.title: Same Time Next Week
segments.text: And finally, for pack regulars, Same Time Next Week. Nearly out of classes? Take the same pack again at fifteen per cent off, plus an extra week of validity so nothing goes to waste. The plan is 5 buyers at about 7,200, so 36,100 rupees.
segments.notes: Pop-up clients whose class pack is running out.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, every first-timer books class two before leaving class one. Week three, we personally call every lapsed member on the list. Week four, close the month, tag every redemption, and brief next month.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's January at Pop-up. 1.93 lakh rupees, three offers, and 51 buyers to welcome. Resolutions fade by February. Our receipts won't.
